summary.tldr: Requires the Canada Revenue Agency to report tax evasion convictions and tax gap statistics, and to share tax gap data with the Parliamentary Budget Officer.
what_it_does: Requires the Canada Revenue Agency annual report to list all tax evasion convictions, with a separate list for international tax evasion.
Requires the annual report, once every three years, to include tax gap statistics for the relevant fiscal year.
Defines the tax gap as taxes that should have been assessed on undeclared income, plus the difference between taxes assessed and taxes collected.
Requires the Minister of National Revenue to collect, compile, analyse and summarise tax gap data for individuals, corporations by size, and trusts resident in Canada.
Requires the Minister to provide the Parliamentary Budget Officer with the tax gap data and any other data the officer asks for.
summary.background: The bill amends the Canada Revenue Agency Act. It adds new reporting rules for tax evasion convictions and for the tax gap.
